latest_autonomous_wave.rationale: Source audit found AW17 cancelled and restarted the family wake task for every replacement. Under a scrub/drag stream faster than the quiet period this resettable debounce could starve Playback generation creation until the user stopped, directly harming P007 seek responsiveness and P008 interactive loop editing. A fixed first-intent window removes starvation without inventing a new device-tuning threshold.
